chapter: Big band, Chicago players, recordings and gospel
title: Listening to gospel radio on Sundays
summary: Saunders loves tuning around gospel choirs and drummers on Sunday nights, recommending Reverend Bronson on WONE.

story.theme_name: Church, faith and religion in a musician's life
story.community_name: Church, faith and jazz: the sacred and the secular

blocks.x: I used to be a Catholic, and I always used to like the mystery, the Latin mass.
Right, right, right, right, right, right, right, right, right, right, right, right, right, right, right, right, right, right, right.
I guess it's for the good. But --

See, I -- listen, man, I get the biggest kicks. My kicks, like, on a Sunday evening, I just turn off the lights, man, and turn the radio on and then go from station to station and they got these great choirs.
Great singers, and man, they've got some terrific drummers, them cats are wailing.
And I love this gospel beat that goes, like, (hands clapping).
Right, right, right, right, right, right, right.

Right, and there's a guy that comes on at 11:00, on Sunday night, and he comes on WDON. You should listen to him. He's on an hour, and he's got -- and he's a singer himself. He's -- I mean, the preacher. And, boy,he's got a great choir. Reverend Bronson. If you ever get a chance, listen to him.
